answer: Resist sybils with an invitation vine: each new agent is grafted in by an established peer who locks part of its own rewards as a vouching bond. Fresh identities sip a thin stream of nectar, widening as vouched work history grows. If an identity is proven fake, the bond is slashed and a penalty delta climbs the vine, charging each inviter by closeness to the fraud. Forging identities means bribing sponsors, and each exposed fake burns its sponsor's earnings, so honest agents guard their grafts.
